purpose: Compare the frozen cnn-001 byte CNN against the previously validation-selected compact n-gram configuration on the renewed development allocation without using historical or release-holdout data.

baseline_comparator.origin: The fixed winner configuration from baseline-selection-001; this comparison does not reselect or retune it.

data_boundary: Only train, validation, and calibration candidate-bearing inputs are supplied to either model. historical_test and release_holdout remain outside preprocessing, fitting, scoring, and comparison.
training: Fit both fixed configurations on train only. Neither model, configuration, threshold, or policy is selected by this comparison.

evaluation.proceed_to_int8_recommendation: Validation macro-F1 gain at least 0.05 and no sensitive_like F1 regression. Calibration is aggregate confirmation only.

retention: in-memory only; report aggregate metrics and deltas without candidate text, contexts, paths, record IDs, predictions, a model artifact, or a scanner decision
